limitations_and_boundaries: Similar to other operator learners, the subspace on which we aim to learn the operator's responses may be infinite dimensional, but the operator must exhibit certain low-dimensional attributes (e.g., smoothing property of the higher frequencies in GRF).
It is not efficient for the attention operator to be applied at the full resolution for a 2D problem, and this limits the approximation to a nonsmooth subset such as functions in L∞.
Due to the order of the matrix product, the proposed linear variant of the scaled dot-product attention is non-causal thus can only apply to encoder-only applications.
